description: List capability contracts with per-call price, SLA, verification history, and 30-day durability (null when no finalized calls were observed). Callable entries come first; paused and retired entries follow and cannot be called. A category filter adds comparable prices and recent clearing data. q searches the contracts; when q matches nothing, data.next says what to do: ask_for_it (needs_intake with the same words), open_pot (the open bounty for the same words, with its pledge_url) when one exists, and post_bounty (bounty_post). Call a capability by its explicit id.

agent_key.description: Optional supplier agent key. Owned repair notices are included when supplied.

q.description: Optional search over each contract's name, the fields it takes and returns, its category and its supplier, with the same word rules as bounties_list q. Results come best match first.

name: capabilities_list
title: List capability contracts and their status
